name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle

locations.note: The game opens with a playable dream of 1936: Indy's escape with the golden idol from the booby-trapped jungle temple, as in Raiders of the Lost Ark.
Woken in his office by a break-in, Indy confronts the giant Locus, who steals a cat mummy from the college museum and knocks him out.
Arriving in Rome after the stolen cat mummy, Indy sneaks through the Blackshirt-held castle and its bastions to meet his friend Antonio from the Vatican.
In a Vatican under Mussolini's Blackshirts Indy meets the reporter Gina Lombardi and learns of the Nephilim and the Great Circle, with a passage under a palace to the tomb of the giant Junia.
Indy works the Nazi dig on the Giza plateau, among the pyramids and under the Sphinx, for the Idol of Ra; Voss leaves him for dead in the desert.
High in the Himalayas Indy and Gina find a Nazi battleship carried up the mountain by the third stone, and Gina's sister Laura frozen to death.
The third stone opens a portal to Shanghai in the middle of the Japanese invasion, where Gantz dies; the pair escape in a hijacked fighter.
In Siam Indy and Gina join the local rebels against Voss's Italian troops, steal his gold to buy a rebreather and follow the legend of a guardian giant to the stone hidden among Sukhothai's temples.
The last site of the Great Circle: at the Ziggurat of Ur Locus calls the Nephilim against the Nazis and Indy rescues Gina.

routes.name: Indiana Jones and Gina Lombardi
routes.note: From a dream of the golden idol and the break-in at Marshall College, Indy and Gina race the Nazis along the Great Circle through Rome and the Vatican to Giza, the Himalayas, Shanghai and Sukhothai, ending in the ziggurat at Ur.
